field.label: Enable Homer
field.help: Enable or disable the Homer dashboard, served via the plugin's own isolated caddy instance.

field.label: Port
field.help: TCP port the dashboard listens on.

field.label: Listen on
field.help: Which address the dashboard binds to. "All interfaces" binds the port on every interface, "LAN IP" binds the configured LAN address, "localhost" binds the loopback address.

field.label: Enable TLS
field.help: Serve the dashboard over HTTPS using caddy's internal certificate authority (tls internal). When the dashboard binds to a specific interface, a Server name (hostname) is required so a certificate can be issued.

field.label: Server name (hostname)
field.help: Hostname used for the TLS certificate, e.g. homer.lan. Required when TLS is enabled and the dashboard does not listen on all interfaces.
